metadata.description: Official Claude Code plugins and skills for the Naffo ERP platform — dairy procurement, accounting, sales, inventory, demand forecasting, production planning, optimization, and business analytics.

skills.name: naffo-erp-guide
skills.description: Core ERP guide — correct tool usage, required fields, party/product resolution, dairy procurement lifecycle, financial report selection, safety rules.

skills.name: naffo-management
skills.description: Day-to-day operations — invoices, payments, receipts, stock checks, dairy procurement cycle, CRM, tasks, financial reports.

skills.name: naffo-optimization
skills.description: Forward-looking planning — demand forecasting, production planning, inventory health, milk procurement optimization, cash flow, anomaly detection.

skills.name: month-end-close
skills.description: Structured month-end bookkeeping close — reconcile transactions, GST check, trial balance, anomaly scan, bank reconciliation.

skills.name: monthly-digest
skills.description: Monthly financial snapshot — sales vs last month, top customers, expense breakdown, anomaly alerts, one recommended action.

skills.name: client-profitability
skills.description: Revenue, outstanding balances, and payment behavior per customer — ranks customers, flags slow payers and concentration risk.

skills.name: revenue-concentration
skills.description: Customer concentration risk — revenue share per client, HHI score, and diversification recommendations.

skills.name: seasonal-patterns
skills.description: Monthly revenue and expense seasonality — seasonal index, peak/trough months, cash planning recommendations for dairy and food businesses.

skills.name: runway-calculator
skills.description: Cash runway — months of operation at current burn rate, three scenarios (current / lean / growth), traffic-light status.

plugins.name: naffo
plugins.description: Work with Naffo ERP from Claude Code — operational management (invoices, payments, stock, dairy, CRM, reports) and business planning (demand forecasting, production planning, inventory optimization, stock transfers).
